analysis.summary: Indo Tech Transformers Limited presented its FY2026 full-year results and Q1 FY2026-27 update, reporting strong revenue and PAT growth alongside improved return metrics and collections. Management outlined a phased capacity-expansion plan targeting 50,000 MVA by FY29, supported by a robust executable order book and favorable market demand across power infrastructure and renewables. The company maintains a strong financial position with near-zero net debt, solid cash reserves, and diversified end-market exposure. Indo Tech Transformers Limited presented its full-year FY2026 results and Q1 FY2026-27 update, highlighting a revenue base of ₹782 Cr and a PAT of ₹93 Cr. Management outlined a phased capacity-expansion plan totaling ₹495 Cr to scale capacity up to 50,000 MVA by FY29.
